name: Stratification Economics
description: Measuring and visualising group inequality; stratification economics and race; means of production and asset ownership; disparities in the modern market economy; traditional explanations of labour market outcomes; intersectionality; intergenerational mobility; access to amenities and public goods; policy debates on reducing group disparities; case studies of group disparities in different contexts.
